xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:TypeOfEventAsPerRegulation30Pa: Options to purchase securities ESOPS (Sub-para 10-Para B)
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StageOfDisclosureOfOptionsToPu: At the time of instituting the scheme
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:BriefDetailsOfOptionsGranted: 3,80,500 Employee stock options to the employees of erstwhile Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited, now the employees of Share India Securities Limited, under the "Share India Employees Stock Option Scheme-II (ESOS-II)", pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with the Company ("Scheme").
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfSharesCoveredByOption: Each of the 3,80,500 options upon vesting thereof, shall be exercisable into 1 equity share of face value of Rs. 2/- each.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:PricingFormulaForOptions: The exercise price of the options was determined as Rs. 2/- per option as per the applicable provisions of the Share India Employees Stock Option Scheme-II (ESOS-II).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTimeWithinWhichOption: The Exercise Period shall commence from the date of Vesting and expire not later than 1 year from the last Vesting Date.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:BriefDetailsOfSignificantTerms: The brief details of the options in terms of the Scheme, are as follows: i) All the Options granted shall be accepted by the grantee by delivering an acceptance form on or before the closing date stated in the grant letter. ii) No amount is payable by the grantee at the time of acceptance of grant of option or at the time of vesting of option. iii) At the time of exercise of options, the grantee shall pay Rs. 2/- per option along with taxes.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DilutedEarningsPerSharePursuan: Options are yet to be exercised.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RemarksForWebsiteDissemination: Since no relevant option is available in the drop-down menu under the stage of disclosure, we have selected “At the time of initiating the scheme”. The present disclosure pertains to the grant of stock options under Share India Employees Stock Option Scheme-II (ESOS-II), pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with Share India Securities Limited.
